'''Squad 79''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[InterStellar Regulators]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Under the orders of [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] engaged the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] strike team but were eliminated in the process. Prior to their assignment on Makeb, at least two members of the squad, its leader and lieutenant, served on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. There they encountered a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was taken out by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].<ref name="Descent into the Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Squad 79 was featured in the [[2013]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. For some reason, a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the squad has pauldrons with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] symbols.<ref name="Descent into the Core" />
